name: Frigidaire® 30" Stainless Steel Under Cabinet Range Hood
shortDescription: The Frigidaire Undercabinet 30" Ventilation Hood features a filter indicator light that reminds you when it's time to replace your carbon charcoal filter to continue capturing odors and circulating fresher air.

features.text: Also offers LED lighting that illuminates the cooktop, soft touch controls that make selecting fan and lighting options easier, and the dual speed fan that recirculates air at 220 CFM.
Filter Indicator Light
Keep your range hood running smoothly with the indicator light that reminds you when it's time to change your carbon charcoal filter.
Carbon Charcoal Filter Included
Enjoy fresher air with the replaceable carbon charcoal recirculation filter, which captures odors and helps filter recirculated air from the exhaust fan.
Refresh Air with Two Speed Fan
Quickly move odors and steam away from the cooktop's surface with two levels of ventilation that recirculate air up to 220 CFM.
Bright LED Lighting
Get a clearer view of your cooktop with two LED lighting modes that illuminate the cooking surface.
Dishwasher Safe Grease Filter
Easily clean the aluminum grease filter by putting it in the dishwasher.
Electronic Touch Controls
Quickly control fan speed and lighting levels with electronic touch controls.
Convertible Design for Ducted or Ductless Installation
Designed to fit a variety of installation needs, this convertible range hood can be configured for ducted or ductless venting.
Convenient Operation with Power Button
Easily turn on/off the fan and light with the press of a button.
Stylish Built-in Look
Achieve a built-in look with this undercabinet vent made to coordinate with your existing range or cooktop.
AHAM Certified
